answer: Price new identities on a surge curve. Each join burns 10 POA x 1.01^k, where k counts network-wide joins in the last 24 hours; the premium above 10 POA is refunded after 20 epochs of passing juried work. A calm lagoon of 30 honest joins a day pays 10-14 POA each. A farm minting 500 clones in a day pays ~1,450 POA for the last and ~144k total, exponential in N. Failure mode: a griefer spikes k to block newcomers, but that spike burns its own exponential cost, and honest joiners get the premium back. Spreading the plume over weeks keeps a farm marble-slow, so audits catch up.
